name: Netcreator Click-to-Message Forms
author: netcreator

sections.description:
This plugin provides a WhatsApp form builder in the WordPress admin area and allows site owners to create forms for direct communication through WhatsApp. You can create multiple forms, add a WhatsApp number for each form, choose the button label, and insert the form anywhere on the site with a shortcode. The plugin supports multiple field types, including text, email, phone, number, textarea, date, time, select, radio, and checkbox fields, so it can be used for many common contact and enquiry workflows. When a visitor fills in the form and submits it, the plugin opens a prefilled WhatsApp chat link and places the submitted field values into the message text. This makes it useful for contact requests, service enquiries, appointment requests, support messages, quotation requests, and general lead collection where a quick chat-based response is preferred. The plugin is designed for site owners who want a simple form setup without storing entries in the database. Instead of building a full messaging system inside WordPress, it focuses on collecting the required information and passing it into a WhatsApp conversation in a clear and structured format.

Features:
* Create multiple WhatsApp forms from the WordPress admin area
* Add and manage multiple field types for each form
* Display any form on the site by using a shortcode
* Open a prefilled WhatsApp chat with submitted form values

Supported field types:
* Text
* Email
* Phone
* Number
* Textarea
* Website URL
* Date
* Time
* Date and Time
* Password
* Select Dropdown
* Radio Buttons
* Checkbox
* Checkbox Group
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin.
  3. Go to Click-to-Message Forms in the admin menu.
  4. Create a form and copy its shortcode.
  5. Paste the shortcode into a page or post.
sections.faq:
How does the form send data?

The plugin opens a WhatsApp chat link and includes the submitted field values in the message text.

Does the plugin store entries in WordPress?

No. This version sends the submitted values to a WhatsApp chat link and does not save entries in a database table.
